incidents.body:
We have monitored for stability and concluded this issue is resolved. 

This incident prevented the Workflow's UI and the Action menu from loading correctly. Further analysis showed this incident caused a delay for Workflows executed manually/scheduled to execute via the UI (ie: On Demand). All impacted Workflows have since processed as expected. 

We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. If you have any questions, please contact our support team by emailing support@bettercloud.com.

incidents.body: Some users experienced errors when when attempting to access BetterCloud Google Administration (g.bettercloud.com) between approximately 6pm ET on 12/3 and 1am ET on 12/4. A related issue causing certain tasks including signature policies, sheet imports/exports, and reports to take longer than expected was fixed today. If you have any questions, please contact our Support Team.
